items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: Highlights in his career included ... studio work with artists including Paul Simon

ctx.x: Just another job. That’s a lot about what a music career is about, isn’t it?

Yeah you’re probably right there, yeah. I’ve been lucky. Because I’ve been lucky to be in more permanent situations than not. You know I’m in a lot of — and when you’re in a permanent situation you can really grow. Because it’s there, it’s going to be more of the same the next night and you can improve on what you got. Otherwise it’s — if you work a job here and you don’t see the same musicians for another two months it’s like a whole new ballgame as opposed to — that’s why I say I enjoy working with the same…

pieces in the thing. And he would go to every individual piece and listen what they were playing in, right next to you, he was standing right next to you while you’re playing. So a record, or a tune that would normally take twenty minutes would take three hours because we had a vast amount of musicians. And so it was more tedious than anything. But you know what? He produced great records all the time so that was his way of getting exactly what he wanted. And he would make these little changes and you’d do it and…
